thought for 24s)Onorchestrator vs. factory — your repo now contains one of each, whichmakes
the difference concrete.

An agent orchestrator makes runtime decisions about who does the work. Your
Meta-Orchestrator is a textbook one: a task arrives, it classifies it, picksa
worker chain, drafts the brief, and supervises with gates and retries. The
intelligence lives in the routing — every task gets a bespoke path, and
judgment (yours and the model&#x27;s) isexercisedpertask.Strength:flexibility
for novel, ambiguous, one-off work. Weakness: eachrunisasnowflake;nothing
forces two similartaskstobehandledthesameway,soqualitydependson
therouterhavingagoodday,andthere&#x27;snostandardtrailacollaboratorcan
 fllow.

A software factory fixes what stages every piece of work passes through. The
pipeline/ you just built is one: five stages, file-based artifactcontracts,
quality gates (held-back tests, the human verdict), and the whole line
portable to any repo or CLI.Theintelligencelivesintheprocessdesign,
doneonce,upfront.Strength:repeatability,auditability,andcollaboration
 — anyone can read a run directory and know exactlywheretheworkstands,follow.
whichiswhyyourchallenges/next-stepsadditionfitsthefactoryhalfso
naturally.Weakness:overheadontasksthatdon&#x27;tneedthefullline(your
skipruleandbackfillrulearethepressurevalvesforthat),andtheprocess
itselfbecomesanartifactyoumustmaintainoritgoesstale.
Theadoptionquestionisless&quot;whichone&quot;thanwhich layer owns which
decision.Inyoursetupthefactoryownsthestages and contracts(everytask
passesresearch→plan→code→validate→publish,artifactsproveit),while
theorchestratorownsexecution within a stage(PIPELINE.md&#x27;sworkermapping
routesphase3tothedeveloperworker,phase1totheresearcher).That
layeringistheusualendstateinmatureteams:factorieswithoutan
orchestratorbecomerigidchecklistsnobodyfollows;orchestratorswithouta
factoryproducecleverone-offsnobodycanauditorhandoff.
Practicalruleofthumbforwhentoleanwhichway:solo,exploratory,or
novelwork→orchestrator-heavy,letjudgmentdriveandkeepceremonyminimal.
Multi-contributor,recurring,ortrust-sensitivework→factory-heavy,
becausethecontractsarewhatletpeople(andfuturesessions)collaborate
withoutsharedmemory.Yourloop-backchangeisaniceexampleofthe
synthesis:thefactorydefinesthelegaltransition(phase3→scopedphase1
→back),butdecidingwhentotakeitisorchestrator-styleruntimejudgment.

 artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly,
d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart
  shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code,

out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system —
  elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral
   placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a
design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a

negligible.

2. In-process degrades superlinearly under concurrency; the daemon is flat.A

during model load. The daemon absorbed the same three in 0.39sttal because
themodelwasalreadyresident.

istead. Both ae defensible — pxus retrieswithfreshcontextratherthan
